title: Vigilant cat follows daily duty to wake little boy every morning reliably
description:
Kristina shared this clip of a cat who takes its self-assigned duty very seriously.

''Our cat loves to wake up our son every morning,'' Kristina told WooGlobe.

While her son was still deep in sleep, the cat carefully approached, nudging and pawing, determined to carry out its daily mission.

It’s a routine the feline follows with unwavering dedication, a tiny guardian ensuring mornings never start late.

Each gentle poke and persistent nudge highlights the commitment of this furry little overseer.
